teaser: You close a car door twice to make sure it has latched, the way you close most things twice before trusting them. Life path 8 and INFP sit at odd angles: one wants the material world mastered, counted, held in a firm hand; the other wants meaning, a cause worth bleeding for, a self kept intact under pressure to perform. In you, the drive to build something lasting meets a temperament that measures success by whether it still feels true, not by what it is worth on paper.
